name: Community — MiniMax H3 (Two-Stage Latent Upscale)
author: LBH-123-AI + lightx2v
description:
MiniMax H3 the way the LTX family does it: a small full-quality first pass, a trained latent upscaler, then a short Turbo refine at your chosen size.

WHY TWO STAGES. Turbo LoRAs are fast but flatten motion; the full 20-step base model keeps the natural nuance but is slow at 768p. This pack runs the full base steps where they are cheap (about 0.36 megapixels, 800x448 at the 768p tier), upscales the LATENT with LBH-123-AI's trained 3D upscaler (no decode/re-encode round trip), and spends the Turbo LoRA only on a 4-step refine at full size. Stage 2 adds real detail: amp logos, LEDs and switches that the small pass only smears resolve cleanly.

Measured 2026-09-02 on a 12 GB RTX 4070 Ti, SimpliGen 1.58.0 / engine ComfyUI 0.34.2, ~19 GB system RAM free, 5 s at 1344x768 (the 768p tier): image-to-video 351 s, reference-to-video 259 s, text-to-video 248 s - 20 base steps at 800x448, the latent upscale, then the 4-step Turbo refine at full size. The same image-to-video shot rendered directly at 768p with the full 20 steps took 882 s. WHY 0.6x AND NOT SMALLER: at 0.45x (608x352) the first pass was about a third faster, but on a close-up singing shot the mouth motion collapsed into pinched, wrinkled cheeks from the third second on - born in the small first pass, and no stage-2 setting could undo it. 0.6x rendered the same shot clean; 0.75x was also clean but cost 557 s.

WHAT IT IS NOT. Not a speed win over a distilled checkpoint: DaSiWa renders 768p directly in about the same time. Pick this for the stock, non-distilled look at 768p in half the time a direct full-steps render costs, not for raw throughput. Not verified above the 768p tier or beyond 5 s; a 15 s clip at 768p is known to exhaust 32 GB of VRAM on the upscale in a third-party test, so expect the higher tiers and long durations to need more than 12 GB.

SETTINGS THAT MATTER. The Steps control is the STAGE-1 step count (default 20). The resolution tier is the FINAL size; stage 1 is always 0.6x of it, snapped to 32. Stage 2 is fixed at 4 steps on the schedule the upscaler's author ships. Sigma shift 12 / 3 on both stages. The Turbo LoRA is applied in stage 2 only; your own LoRAs (the LoRA slot) apply to both.

REQUIRES the Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler custom node pinned at commit d7c01b9 or later. The previous commit (6a4b191) produced scrambled output - blobby backgrounds, cyan skin - on this exact graph; that is the whole reason this pack did not exist a day earlier. Adds one 0.69 GB upscaler model and the 2 GB Turbo LoRA; the base weights are the official Comfy-Org pruned INT8 files shared with every other H3 pack.

extensions.name: ComfyUI-KJNodes
extensions.description: Provides PathchSageAttentionKJ. The workflow does not patch attention itself; SimpliGen injects it when Faster Attention is on (supportsSage), and the node must be installed for that injection to resolve.

extensions.name: Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler
extensions.description: Trained neural latent upscaler for MiniMax H3 (MinimaxH3LatentUpscaler3D). MUST be at commit d7c01b9 or later: 6a4b191 scrambles the second stage (blobby background, cyan skin) on this exact graph. No requirements.txt, torch only.

requirements.notes: Official Comfy-Org pruned INT8 base weights shared with the other H3 packs, plus the 0.69 GB LBH-123-AI latent upscaler and the 2 GB lightx2v Turbo 4-step LoRA. Needs the Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler custom node at d7c01b9 or later - the earlier commit scrambles stage 2. Measured 2026-09-02 on a 12 GB RTX 4070 Ti, SimpliGen 1.58.0 / engine ComfyUI 0.34.2, ~19 GB system RAM free, 5 s at 1344x768 (the 768p tier): image-to-video 351 s, reference-to-video 259 s, text-to-video 248 s - 20 base steps at 800x448, the latent upscale, then the 4-step Turbo refine at full size. The same image-to-video shot rendered directly at 768p with the full 20 steps took 882 s. WHY 0.6x AND NOT SMALLER: at 0.45x (608x352) the first pass was about a third faster, but on a close-up singing shot the mouth motion collapsed into pinched, wrinkled cheeks from the third second on - born in the small first pass, and no stage-2 setting could undo it. 0.6x rendered the same shot clean; 0.75x was also clean but cost 557 s. Only the 768p tier at 5 s has been run on 12 GB; a 15 s clip at 768p OOMed on the upscale at 32 GB VRAM in a third-party test, so treat the 928p/1088p tiers and long durations as untested. Free system RAM is the usual H3 constraint: below ~2 GB free the decode can fail with 'HostBuffer.read_file_slice failed'.
